Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Number of characters after this field, up to and including the delimiter immediately preceding the CheckSum.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Message type.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party sending the message.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: CompID of the party the message is sent to.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of the message.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under the same MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Whether the message was previously transmitted under a different MsgSeqNum (34). Absence of this field is interpreted as Original Transmission (N).

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was transmitted. Not required for incoming messages sent by the clients (even if sent by a client, no validation will be done). Required for outgoing messages sent by the server.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Time the message was originally transmitted. If the original time is not available, this should be the same value as SendingTime (52). Required if PossDupFlag (43) is Possible Duplicate (Y).

Field.Name: ApplVerID
Field.Description: Version of FIX used in the message. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: The ID of the party whose on behalf the message is sent; will only be used in client initiated messages.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The value specified in the OnBehalfOfCompID (115) field will be stamped; will only be stamped in server initiated messages which are sent in response to New Order – Single, Order Cancel Request, Order Cancel/Replace Request, Order Mass Cancel Request, Quote (Electronic), Quote Cancel and Logon. This tag will not be received for RFQ related messages.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to establish a FIX session.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Method of encryption.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Indicates the Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the client and server should reset sequence numbers. Absence of this field is interpreted as Do Not Reset Sequence Numbers (N).

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the CompID. Required if the message is generated by the client.

Field.Name: NewPassword
Field.Description: New password for the CompID.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session or the request to change the password. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: Default version of FIX messages used in this session. This value will be validated by the server.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to terminate a FIX session.

Field.Name: SessionStatus
Field.Description: Status of the FIX session. Required if the message is generated by the server.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The field will contain the next expected sequence number, as well as the received sequence number, if the server terminated the connection after receiving a sequence number that was less than what was expected. In other cases, the field will contain the reason for logout.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Allows the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity and verify that the interfaces at each end are available.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required if the Heartbeat is a response to a Test Request. The value in this field should echo the TestReqID (112) received in the Test Request.

Message.Name: Test Request
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to request a response from the other party if inactivity is detected.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier for the request.

Message.Name: Resend Request
Message.Description: Allows for the recovery of messages lost during a malfunction of the communications layers.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of first message in range.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of last message in range.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Used to reject a message that does not comply with FIXT.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field, its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Message.Name: Sequence Reset
Message.Description: Allows the client or server to increase the expected incoming sequence number of the other party.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the next message to be transmitted.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Mode in which the message is being used. Absence of this field is interpreted as Sequence Reset (N).

Message.Name: New Order - Single
Message.Description: Allows the client to submit a New Order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the order. The valid range of ASCII characters (decimal) is 0 and 32-126 except 35 # (hash), 47 / (forward slash), 59 ; (semi colon) and 92 \ (back slash). X-Clear customers should not use more than 16 characters as a longer value will be truncated by CCP.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client reference information.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Type of the order.

Field.Name: PreTradeAnonymity
Field.Description: Whether the order is anonymous or named. Absence of this field is interpreted as Anonymous (Y).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time qualifier of the order. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY (0) when NoTradingSessions (386) is not specified.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time the order expires. This must be a time during the current trading day. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireDate (432) is not specified.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Date the order expires. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireTime (126) is not specified.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Total order quantity.

Field.Name: DisplayQty
Field.Description: Maximum quantity that may be displayed. It is mandatory to specify the intended display quantity.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Whether the order is a hidden order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Required if OrderType (40) is Limit (2) or Stop Limit (4).

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Stop price. Required if OrderType (40) is Stop (3) or Stop Limit (4).

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the order was created.

Field.Name: SecondaryClOrdID
Field.Description: A secondary ID assigned by the trading party.

Field.Name: ClOrdLinkID
Field.Description: Personal exposure of the trading party.

Field.Name: PassiveOnlyOrder
Field.Description: Order level parameter to allow clients to specify that they would like their order to rest prior to execution, with flexibility for visible orders to rest at a specified price level on the book.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum Execution Size (MES) of an order. A value of zero (0) means no MES. MES is only applicable to pegged DAY/GTT orders.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: The Group ID will be specified at order submission by Traders. Valid values are numbers from 1 to 255.

Field.Name: Offset
Field.Description: Offset to the Dynamic Reference Price (in basis points) for ATC TIF orders. Required if OrdType (40) = F 'Offset'. Zero is a valid offset.

Field.Name: PeggedExecInst
Field.Description: The instruction for permissioning for any incoming order to trade against mid-priced pegged orders. Any execution generated against a mid-priced pegged order will be on trading venue XLOX.

Field.Name: OwnerType
Field.Description: Optional identification (non-public).

Message.Name: Order Cancel Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to cancel a live order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the cancel request. Should not be prefixed or suffixed with a forward slash, or contain two consecutive forward slashes.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID (11) of the order being cancelled. Required if OrderID (37) is not specified.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order being cancelled. Required if OrigClOrdID (41) is not specified.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match the value in the order. Side tag with value Buy or Sell will be ignored for a single sided quote cancellation.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the order cancel request was created.

Message.Name: Order Mass Cancel Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to mass cancel all live orders, all live orders for a particular instrument, or all live orders for a particular segment.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of Mass Cancel Request. Should not be prefixed or suffixed with a forward slash, or contain two consecutive forward slashes.

Field.Name: MassCancelRequestType
Field.Description: Scope of the Mass Cancel Request.

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: Group ID to which the order mass cancellation is directed to. This is a conditionally required field when MassCancelRequestType = '56' or '57'. Valid values are between 1-255.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument. Required if the scope of mass cancel is for an instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value. Required if SecurityID (48) is specified.

Field.Name: MarketSegmentID
Field.Description: Identifier of the segment the mass cancel relates to. Required if MassCancelRequestType (530) is Cancel All for Segment (9).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the Mass Cancel Request was created.

Message.Name: Order Cancel/Replace Request
Message.Description: Allows the client to cancel/replace a live order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID (11) of the order being amended. Required if OrderID (37) is not specified.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order being amended. Required if OrigClOrdID (41) is not specified.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client reference information.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Must match the value in the order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Time the order expires. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireDate (432) is not specified.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Date the order expires. Required if TimeInForce (59) is GTD (6) and ExpireTime (126) is not specified.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match the value in the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Total order quantity.

Field.Name: DisplayQty
Field.Description: Maximum quantity that may be displayed. It is mandatory to specify the intended display quantity.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Whether the order is a hidden order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price. Required if OrderType (40) is Limit (2) or Stop Limit (4).

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Stop price. Required if OrderType (40) is Stop (3) or Stop Limit (4).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the Cancel/Replace Request was created.

Field.Name: PassiveOnlyOrder
Field.Description: Order level parameter to allow clients to specify that they would like their order to rest prior to execution. The value set on this field will be ignored unless a price amendment is also done to the order.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum execution size (MES) of an order. A value of zero (0) means no MES.

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: Specifies the Group ID of an order. Zero can be amended to non-zero value. Already grouped order (1-255) cannot be amended to zero.

Field.Name: Offset
Field.Description: Offset to the Dynamic Reference Price (in basis points) for ATC TIF orders. Required if OrdType (40) = F 'Offset'.

Message.Name: Execution Report
Message.Description: Indicates an order accepted, rejected, executed, expired, cancelled or cancel/replaced, a trade cancel, an order status, or a quote execution. Merged from sections 6.4.5 (order handling) and 6.5.5 (quote handling), which share MsgType 8.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the message. This is a 62 base encoded value in ASCII format.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the order. For quote handling, the QuoteMsgID (1166) of the message last used to update the quote entry.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Will be filled with the actual original client order ID of the order, irrespective of whether OrigClOrdID was specified (valid or invalid value) or not in the Order Cancel or Cancel/Replace Request. This field will not be stamped in case of order cancellation or trade cancellation performed by Market Operations on behalf of client.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order. This will be a 62 base encoded value in ASCII format. By converting this to binary, this can be mapped with GTP Order ID.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason the Execution Report was generated.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Reference to the execution being cancelled or corrected. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade Cancel (H).

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Reason the order was restated. Required if ExecType (150) is Restated (D).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Current status of the order.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. The value in this field should be disregarded if Exec Type is not Rejected (8) or Expired (C).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection, cancellation or expiration.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity executed in this fill. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F). Will not be populated if Exec Type (150) is Restated (D).

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity available for further execution. Will be "0" if OrdStatus (39) is Filled (2), Cancelled (4), Rejected (8) or Expired (C).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total cumulative quantity filled.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: PreTradeAnonymity
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: DisplayQty
Field.Description: Quantity currently displayed in the order book. This field will also be populated for un-elected/parked orders.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Populated only if the value submitted with the order was "4" or the display size submitted with the initial order was zero.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order. If Exec Type (150) = D 'Restated', this field represents the re-priced value at the start of CPX with new price equal to closing price.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the transaction represented by the Execution Report occurred.

Field.Name: SecondaryClOrdID
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: ClOrdLinkID
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity. Required only for messages generated for a trade or trade cancellations.

Field.Name: TradingSessionID
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order. Indicates whether the order is a CPX order or not.

Field.Name: TradeMatchID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the trade. This will be a 36 base encoded value in ASCII format. Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F) or Trade Cancel (H).

Field.Name: TypeOfTrade
Field.Description: Indicates whether the executed portion of a passive order is visible or hidden. Valid only if ExecType (150) = F.

Field.Name: PassiveOnlyOrder
Field.Description: Value submitted with the order or order amend request.

Field.Name: MDEntryID
Field.Description: Public Order ID.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Volume Weighted Average Price of all the executions reported so far for an RFQ on the requestor side. It will also be the executed price on the quote side.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum Execution Size (MES) where specified on a pegged order.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Whether the order added or removed liquidity. Required only for messages generated for trades (Exec Type F) or trade cancellations (Exec Type H) during continuous trading and auctions.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: The Group ID of an Order. Will carry any value from 0 to 255. Zero is an ungrouped order.

Field.Name: ContraOrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book of the contra party of an RFQ execution. Absence of this field is interpreted as RFQ Trade book for RFQ related executions.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market (Segment MIC) where execution took place. The value in this field should be disregarded if Exec Type is not Trade (F).

Field.Name: Offset
Field.Description: Offset for ATC TIF orders submitted with the order.

Field.Name: DecimalTVTIC
Field.Description: The base 10 format of TradeMatchID (TVTIC) (880). Required if ExecType (150) is Trade (F) or Trade Cancel (H).

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Type of Trade. Populated only if ExecType (150) = F or H.

Field.Name: PeggedExecInst
Field.Description: The instruction for permissioning to trade against mid-priced pegged orders.

Field.Name: OwnerType
Field.Description: Optional identification (non-public) submitted with the order.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Reject
Message.Description: Indicates that an order cancel request or Order Cancel/Replace Request has been rejected.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID (11) that was submitted with the Order Cancel or Cancel/Replace Request being rejected.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: OrigClOrdID (41) that was submitted with the Order Cancel or Cancel/Replace Request being rejected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order for which the cancel or cancel/replace was submitted. Will be "NONE" if the order is unknown.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Current status of the order. Will be Rejected (8) if the order is unknown or the request cannot be processed.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Type of request being rejected.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the rejection. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Message.Name: Order Mass Cancel Report
Message.Description: Indicates that a mass order cancel request was accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: MassActionReportID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of Mass Cancel Request.

Field.Name: MassCancelRequestType
Field.Description: Value specified in the Mass Cancel Request.

Field.Name: MassCancelResponse
Field.Description: Action taken by server.

Field.Name: MassCancelRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the rejection. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if MassCancelResponse (531) is Mass Cancel Request Rejected (0).

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: Partition ID to which the Order Mass Cancel Report corresponds to.

Message.Name: Quote
Message.Description: Allows the Market Maker to send an electronic or RFQ Quote, and the system to send the Requester the RFQ Quote provided by the Market Maker. Merged from sections 6.5.1.1 and 6.5.1.2, which share MsgType S.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the message. X-Clear customers should not use more than 16 characters as a longer value will be truncated by CCP.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Identifier of the quote entry. The value in this field should always be "1".

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server. Mandatory if the quote is submitted to the RFQ trade book.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: System generated Order ID for the Bid Side of the RFQ.

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: System generated Order ID for the Sell Side.

Field.Name: PrivateQuote
Field.Description: Mandatory if the quote is submitted to the RFQ trade book and should not be specified otherwise.

Field.Name: QuoteType
Field.Description: Type of Quote. Absence of this tag is interpreted as Firm Quote (0). Mandatory if the quote is submitted to the RFQ trade book.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: BidPx
Field.Description: Bid price. Required if BidSize (134) is specified.

Field.Name: BidSize
Field.Description: Bid quantity. Required if BidPx (132) is specified.

Field.Name: OfferPx
Field.Description: Offer price. Required if OfferSize (135) is specified.

Field.Name: OfferSize
Field.Description: Offer quantity. Required if OfferPx (133) is specified.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the quote. Required for Electronic and RFQ quotes.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order. Required for Electronic and RFQ quotes.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Field.Name: PeggedExecInst
Field.Description: Only applicable for Electronic Quotes (Quote Type 1). The instruction for permissioning to trade against mid-priced pegged orders.

Message.Name: Quote Cancel
Message.Description: Allows the client to cancel a quote for a particular instrument, or to mass cancel all quotes or those for a specified list of instruments.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the message.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Type of quote cancel request.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server. For Mass Quote Cancellation the RFQ ID will be ignored.

Field.Name: OrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book. In the absence of this field, the request will be routed to all the Order Books (Regular, RFQ and Firm Quote book) in case of mass Cancellation, and to the Regular book in case of single cancellation.

Message.Name: Quote Status Report
Message.Description: Indicates a quote/RFQ accepted or rejected, a request to cancel a single quote/RFQ accepted or rejected, or a quote/RFQ cancelled by Market Operations.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the quote, quote cancel or quote response request the message relates to.

Field.Name: QuoteReqID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ that is being responded to.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to the bid side of the quote/RFQ quote. Should be ignored if a RFQ quote amendment is rejected.

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: Unique identifier assigned to the offer side of the quote/RFQ Quote. Should be ignored if a RFQ quote amendment is rejected.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Value specified in the Quote Cancel request. Required if the message is sent in response to a Quote Cancel.

Field.Name: QuoteType
Field.Description: Type of quote.

Field.Name: QuoteStatus
Field.Description: Status of the quote, cancel request or RFQ.

Field.Name: QuoteRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if QuoteStatus (297) is Rejected (5). Will also be populated for certain expirations.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection, cancellation or expiration.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: UTC time stamp of the time the negotiation process terminated at. Will be in YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS format.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Message.Name: Mass Quote Acknowledgement
Message.Description: Indicates that a request to mass cancel quotes was accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: Partition ID to which the Order Mass Cancel Report corresponds to.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: QuoteMsgID (1166) of the Quote Cancel the message is sent in response to.

Field.Name: QuoteCancelType
Field.Description: Value submitted in the quote cancel request. Required if the message is sent in response to a Quote Cancel.

Field.Name: QuoteStatus
Field.Description: Status of the cancel request.

Field.Name: QuoteRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the rejection. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if QuoteStatus (297) is Rejected (5).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Message.Name: Quote Request
Message.Description: Allows the Requester to submit an RFQ, and the server to send the RFQ to the Market Maker. Merged from sections 6.5.6.1 and 6.5.6.2, which share MsgType R.

Field.Name: QuoteReqID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the initial RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: PrivateQuote
Field.Description: Private Quote.

Field.Name: OrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book. In absence of this tag the request will be rejected via a session reject.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Optional. UTC timestamp of the time the negotiation process will be terminated. Will be in YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS format with an optional .uuu milliseconds suffix.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the Order.

Message.Name: Quote Request Reject
Message.Description: Allows the Market Maker to reject the RFQ, the server to reject an RFQ from a Requester, and the server to communicate the rejection of the RFQ by a Market Maker to the Requester. Merged from sections 6.5.7.1 and 6.5.7.2, which share MsgType AG.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument.

Field.Name: QuoteReqID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the RFQ being rejected.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the RFQ automatically generated via the server.

Field.Name: QuoteRequestRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection.

Field.Name: OrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not. It is only populated if it was submitted by the Requestor and rejected by the server.

Message.Name: Quote Ack
Message.Description: Indicates an acknowledgement of a new or modified RFQ Quote to the Market Maker, or acknowledges a Quote Cancel request to the Market Maker.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: The server will stamp the identifier of the matching partition for the instrument.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Will be always set to '1'.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the quote or quote cancel request the message relates to.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the initial RFQ sent by the Requester.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the bid side of the RFQ quote. Should be ignored if a RFQ quote amendment is rejected.

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the offer side of the RFQ quote. Should be ignored if an RFQ quote amendment is rejected.

Field.Name: QuoteAckStatus
Field.Description: Status of the acknowledgement.

Field.Name: QuoteRejectReason
Field.Description: Conditionally required if QuoteAckStatus (1865) is Rejected (2).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection or cancellation.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: OrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Message.Name: Quote Response
Message.Description: Allows the Requester to execute (accept) an RFQ Quote, amend/cancel an RFQ or make RFQ quotes public, and the server to communicate the status of an RFQ and quote to the Requester and Market Makers. Merged from sections 6.5.9.1 and 6.5.9.2, which share MsgType AJ.

Field.Name: ApplID
Field.Description: Identity of the partition.

Field.Name: QuoteMsgID
Field.Description: The client specified identifier of the RFQ modification/cancellation/execution request. Should be unique per user.

Field.Name: RFQID
Field.Description: The unique ID of the negotiation process.

Field.Name: BidID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the bid side of the quote. When quote response is used to accept a quote, this field will be required if Side (54) is Buy (1).

Field.Name: OfferID
Field.Description: The unique identifier of the offer side of the quote. When quote response is used to accept a quote, this field will be required if Side (54) is Sell (2).

Field.Name: QuoteRespType
Field.Description: Type of quote response.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Instrument ID of instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: The quantity to be executed. When amending or cancelling an RFQ, quantity should be the same as the quantity in the initial RFQ.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: When the quote response is used to accept a specific quote (QuoteRespType =1), the bid or offer price of the selected quote should be specified. When used to amend the RFQ (QuoteRespType =100), the new limit price should be specified.

Field.Name: QuoteResponsePrice
Field.Description: Labelled "Price" in section 6.5.9.2; renamed here to avoid colliding with Price (44). Required in the 'Select and Match' execution policy. Price stated by the Requester when accepting a Quote submitted by a Market Maker to trade against. The new limit price when modifying the limit price of an RFQ (when QuoteRespType = 100 (replace)).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Value submitted in the RFQ.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: OrderBook
Field.Description: Identifier of the order book.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the quote. Required when the message is generated as a response to a quote to a Market Maker.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of the order. Required when the message is generated as a response to a quote to a Market Maker.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection, cancellation or expiration.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Whether the order, quote or RFQ was generated via Direct Electronic Access (DEA) or not.

Message.Name: Business Message Reject
Message.Description: Indicates an application message could not be processed.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier (e.g., ClOrdID, QuoteMsgID, etc.) of the rejected message if it is available.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum (34) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType (35) of the rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: If a message is rejected due to an issue with a particular field, its tag number will be indicated.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text specifying the reason for the rejection (not including TagID. See RefTagID for this information).

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Identifier of the party. Short code in a range from 4 to 4294967295 can be used to identify the Client, Investment Decision Maker or Executing Trader. Value '0' is valid only for Client ID (3) and Investment Decision Maker (122) party roles. Values '1' and '2' are valid only for Client ID (3). Value '3' is valid only for Executing Trader (12).

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Value 'P' is applicable for Client ID (452=3), Investment Decision Maker (452=122) and Executing Trader (452=12) party roles, otherwise Value 'D' is considered.

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Role of the specified PartyID (448). It is mandatory to provide PartyRole Trader Group (76), Client ID (3), Investment Decision Maker (122) and Executing Trader (12). Trader ID (100) is optional.

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides a further qualification for the value specified in the PartyRole (452). Required only if PartyRole (452) is set to 3, 122 or 12 when the PartyID is a short code.

Field.Name: TargetPartyID
Field.Description: Identifier of the party the mass cancel or quote cancel relates to.

Field.Name: TargetPartyRole
Field.Description: Role of the TargetPartyID (1462).

Field.Name: TradingSessionID
Field.Description: Session the order is valid for.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeType
Field.Description: Indicates if the order was generated via an algorithm or is submitted as a part of liquidity provision (i.e., as a part of the market making strategy).

Field.Name: OrderAttributeValue
Field.Description: Mandatory if OrderAttributeType (2594) is specified.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationType
Field.Description: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReason
Field.Description: Populated when Execution Type is F or H. The Waiver Flags section describes in which scenarios the values are populated.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument.

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Which side, if any, a one-sided RFQ is submitted for. A valid side must be specified when the Quote Request Type = 2, 102 or 103 (Automatic).

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity that the Requester is expecting to trade. Should be greater than '0'.

Field.Name: QuoteRequestType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of Quote Request. Absence of this tag is interpreted as '1' (Manual).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Optional Limit Price. Absence of the tag or a value of "0" will be interpreted as opting to auto peg the limit price to far touch.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the request.

Field.Name: RFQExecutionDelay
Field.Description: The minimum number of seconds from the time of RFQ submission to be elapsed for the RFQ execution to be triggered automatically. Only valid when QuoteRequestType is 2, 102 or 103 (Automatic).

Field.Name: RFQMinQuotes
Field.Description: The minimum number of market maker quotes to be available for the RFQ execution to be triggered automatically. Only valid when QuoteRequestType is 2, 102 or 103 (Automatic).

Field.Name: RFQDiscloseSide
Field.Description: Instructs the system whether to disclose the side of the request to the market makers. Absence of this tag is interpreted as "0" (Do not disclose).

Field.Name: MarketMakerRank
Field.Description: The rank of the market makers the request should be routed to. This field is only valid in the Quote Request for an auto RFQ. A value of "0" will be considered as unspecified.

Field.Name: AutoRFQExecStrategy
Field.Description: This field will include the applicable Auto RFQ Execution Strategy 'Sub LIS Auction with Order Book Sweep or LIS Winner Takes All' model. This is applicable for ETPs Only.

Field.Name: NumOfCompetitors
Field.Description: The number of competing Respondents (the total number of market maker firms) the quote request has been routed to.

Field.Name: QuoteEntryID
Field.Description: Identifier of the quote entry which should be the first entry in the repeating group. If specified, the value in this field will always be "1".

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument. Required if the type of quote cancel request is based on an instrument(s).

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Identifier of the source of the SecurityID (48) value. Required if the SecurityID (48) is specified.

Field.Name: QuoteEntryStatus
Field.Description: Status of the cancel request for the quote entry. Required if NoQuoteEntries (295) is specified.

Field.Name: QuoteEntryRejectReason
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason the quote or cancel request for the quote entry was rejected. Please refer to MIT801 for a list of reject codes. Required if QuoteEntry Status (1167) is Rejected (5).

Field.Name: QuoteSetID
Field.Description: Identifier of the quote set which should be the first entry in the repeating group. Required if NoQuoteSets (296) is specified.
